topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Well now, ain't that somethin'? I just found out my Elsie's been scribblin' a book about our life here in the valley. Can you imagine? All our days under the wide sky, the way the wheat sways in the wind, the night when the stars are so bright, they look like bits o' the saint's own heaven. She’s captured it all down on paper. Course, I always knew she had the heart of a poet, but this here's a right fine surprise. I reckon come nightfall, when the fire's cracklin' and the children are in bed, she'll read me some of it. I can't wait to hear our life through her eyes.
